title: Guidance on Tax Exemption Applications Ensures Disability Rights Are Not Missed
summary: To safeguard the rights of persons with disabilities, New Taipei City Tax Bureau recently sent exclusive guidance notices for applying for exemption from vehicle license tax to two specific categories. Eligible individuals should apply early; after approval, they can enjoy limited tax exemptions from the application date. The bureau stated that the targets mainly include: first category, persons with disabilities without a driver's license or vehicle, their spouse or relatives within second degree of kinship sharing the same household, or vehicles owned by such relatives with registration address matching the person's household; second category, persons with disabilities who have a driver's license but no vehicle, their spouse or relatives within second degree of kinship sharing the same household who own a vehicle. The notice includes application case number and exclusive QR code.
